name_ja: 上野の森ハーフマラソン 東京新聞杯
name_en: Ueno no Mori Half Marathon Tokyo Shimbun Cup
full_name_ja: 第13回 上野の森ハーフマラソン 東京新聞杯
full_name_en: The 13th Ueno no Mori Half Marathon Tokyo Shimbun Cup
description_ja: 美術館・博物館・寺社仏閣が集まる「上野の森」で開催される、上野公園と不忍池を周回するハーフマラソン大会。第1回から地元関係者の協力で運営されており、レース後は文化施設巡りやアメ横・御徒町での買い物や食事も楽しめる。ハーフ、10km、3kmの種目がある。
description_en: This half marathon is held in Ueno no Mori, an area with many art museums, museums, temples and shrines, and the course loops around Ueno Park and Shinobazu Pond. It has been run with the cooperation of local people since the first edition. After the race, participants can visit the cultural facilities or shop and dine in Ameyoko and Okachimachi. Races are offered in the half marathon, 10km and 3km.
reception_note_ja: アスリートビブスと計測チップは事前発送。受付および参加賞の受け取り場所は精養軒駐車場。ゴール後にビブスのチェックを受けてから参加賞を受け取る。計測チップの返却は不要。
reception_note_en: Athlete bibs and timing chips are mailed in advance. Reception and collection of participation prizes take place at the Seiyoken parking lot. After finishing, runners have their bibs checked before receiving the participation prize. Timing chips do not need to be returned.

categories.description_ja: 男女別。18歳以上（高校生不可）。関門は12.33km地点で1時間33分。
categories.description_en: Separate men's and women's divisions. Age 18 and over (high school students not eligible). Cut-off gate at the 12.33km point at 1 hour 33 minutes.

categories.description_ja: 男女別。15歳以上（中学生不可）。
categories.description_en: Separate men's and women's divisions. Age 15 and over (junior high school students not eligible).

categories.description_ja: 保護者と小学生のペア。定員は100組。
categories.description_en: A pair of a guardian and an elementary school child. Capacity is 100 pairs.

categories.description_ja: 小学生が対象。参加費は無料。スポーツエントリーのみで申込可能。
categories.description_en: For elementary school students. Free of charge. Entry is available only through Sports Entry.
For junior high school students and older.
